description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories related to the capabilities or challenges of language models, as referenced in the paper "Can Language Models Follow Multiple Turns of Entangled Instructions." The chart is divided into 10 slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories and their corresponding colors and approximate proportions are as follows: Contradiction Resolution (brown, approximately 14%), Context Tracking (dark blue, approximately 14%), Context Retrieving (green, approximately 14%), Multitasking (teal, approximately 17%), Dynamic Instruction (light teal, approximately 11%), Memorization (light blue, approximately 11%), Dynamic Environment (blue, approximately 11%), Recursive Reasoning (light blue, approximately 12%), Prioritization (red, approximately 11%), Personalization (pink, approximately 11%), and Privacy Protection (dark pink, approximately 12%). The chart does not include a legend, but labels are provided outside the chart for each slice, and the proportions are roughly equal, with some variation. The slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise order, with no particular slice visually emphasized.
